title: Senior Product Manager, Shipment Visibility
posting_text:
Harborline gives 2,000 shippers one view of every load in motion.

What you'll do
- Own the roadmap for real-time tracking, ETA prediction and exception alerts
- Partner with data science on ETA accuracy
- Work with carriers and shippers to define integrations

What we're looking for
- 6+ years of B2B product management
- Experience with shipment visibility or transportation software
- Comfort with APIs, webhooks and event data
- Clear written communication with executives

Nice to have
- Experience with machine-learning products
- Usage-based pricing experience

Travel: up to 10%.
